fields.description: Entrega 12 (Grupos): quando setado, esta conversa É a thread do grupo -- contact/phone_number/wa_id ficam irrelevantes (mesma convenção "sem aba vazia" do funil da Entrega 7), e o remetente de cada mensagem inbound é o participante que enviou, não este grupo.
fields.label: WhatsApp Group

fields.description: Canonical/normalized number used to group messages into this conversation (Brazilian mobile numbers' ambiguous 9th digit stripped — see takion_whatsapp.utils.normalize_phone_number). Internal matching key only — not shown to agents, use phone_number_display for that, and wa_id for sending. Irrelevant/blank for a group conversation (see whatsapp_group).
fields.label: Phone Number

fields.description: Human-facing number, always with the Brazilian 9th digit reinserted (every real BR mobile number has it — see takion_whatsapp.utils.format_phone_number_display). Derived from phone_number at creation, shown in the conversation list/thread.
fields.label: Phone

fields.description: Raw wa_id as last reported by Meta on an inbound message from this contact — used verbatim as the "to" when sending replies, since it's the form Meta itself most recently confirmed as deliverable.
fields.label: WhatsApp ID (send-to)

fields.description: Reuses Frappe's native Contact doctype (no new entity) — resolved by phone number, auto-created (phone number only) if no match exists.
fields.label: Contact

fields.description: Plain configurable Select (not Kanban) — add/rename options via Customize Form.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Novo
Em andamento
Aguardando cliente
Resolvido

fields.description: Set on every inbound message (client/conversation.py), cleared when an operator opens the conversation (client/inbox.py::mark_conversation_read) or replies. Independent of `status` -- a conversation can be "Em andamento" and still unread, or "Resolvido" and briefly unread again if the customer writes back.
fields.label: Não lida

fields.description: Meta's click-to-WhatsApp ad click id, from the `referral` object on this contact's first inbound message. Only ever set once (first inbound message wins) -- see client/attribution.py.
fields.label: CTWA Click ID

fields.description: Set only on the inbound-when-empty transition (a new customer message with no reply pending yet), cleared on the next outbound message -- see client/conversation.py. NOT the same as last_message_at, which is overwritten by every message including inbound and would never hold still long enough to measure a wait.
fields.label: First Unanswered Inbound At

fields.description: Computed every few minutes by client/sla.py against WhatsApp SLA Settings' thresholds -- never set directly.
fields.label: SLA

fields.description: Definido por client/optout.py ao detectar uma palavra-chave de descadastro (WhatsApp Broadcast Settings) numa mensagem inbound -- filtra este número tanto na montagem quanto no envio de qualquer Bulk WhatsApp Message. Não afeta respostas de atendimento normais, só transmissões.
fields.label: Optou por sair (transmissões)
